name: Lazy Coremata
description:
1️⃣The life-core of something that clearly was not trying very hard.
It barely pulses, which honestly explains how easily you took it.

name: Stirring Coremata
description:
2️⃣This one still twitches every few seconds.
Apparently nobody told it that the rest of its owner stopped participating.

name: Beating Coremata
description:
3️⃣A core still beating away at a steady, healthy rhythm.
Deeply unsettling to haul around in a sack, but great for JAFTING.

name: Thundering Coremata
description:
4️⃣You can feel it pulsating through the bag without even opening it.
There is no good answer for why you picked up the gross ass thing.

name: Undying Coremata
description:
5️⃣It has been three weeks and this fucking thing will not stop beating.
At some point you gave it a name, and that was a serious mistake.

name: Odorless Powder
description:
1️⃣It isn't clear what this is, because it smells absolutely like nothing.
You probably should be cautious how you use this.

name: Odorful Powder
description:
2️⃣Now that it can be smelled, it is undecided as to which is worse:
being able to smell it, or not being able to smell it.

name: Ghastly Powder
description:
3️⃣A truly ghastly-smelling powder that you probably should not have picked up.
Why did you pick up a pile of this anyway? It is literal death.

name: Spectral Powder
description:
4️⃣This death powder- in addition to smelling rancid-
also appears to be glowing with the regret of 1000 wishes left unfulfilled.

name: Transparent Powder
description:
5️⃣This powder is not just hard to grasp, but also hard to see due to it being
almost entirely invisible... but the smell. Ohhhh the smell. Sweet fucking hell it is awful.

name: Hot Crumbles
description:
1️⃣Warm little pebbles that were definitely inside something living until recently.
That warmth is not residual body heat, in case you were hoping.

name: Glowing Crumbles
description:
2️⃣These give off a soft green light even through the bag.
It would be wise to keep them somewhere other than with the food.

name: Humming Crumbles
description:
3️⃣A quiet enough room reveals that these have been humming the entire time.
Whatever powers them is apparently still on the clock.

name: Unstable Crumbles
description:
4️⃣These have started clicking, and the clicking speeds up the closer you get.
Nobody in this line of work is remotely qualified to interpret that.

name: Critical Crumbles
description:
5️⃣At some point these stopped being a material and became an event.
They are vibrating and should probably be used soon- whatever "using" looks like.

name: Broken Horn
description:
1️⃣The horn off of a deceased bull or minataur most likely.
Because you roughed 'em up, its horn is also broken.

name: Cracked Horn
description:
2️⃣A horn that is slightly cracked, likely from the concussive blow you left
the original owner with upon goring off their body.

name: Long Horn
description: 3️⃣A rather long horn, still intact surprisingly, and kinda sharp.

name: Demon Horn
description:
4️⃣A horn off a world-renowned demon that surely felt great shame when you ripped off
their only way of compensating for their size.

name: Regal Horn
description:
5️⃣A mighty horn glimmering and sparkling due to the studded gems.
Yes, you read that right: this is a diamond-encrusted horn.

name: Tough Root
description:
1️⃣This root is outrageously durable for how withered and busted
it looks.

name: Sprouting Root
description:
2️⃣A root that is sprouting little tendrils out, though they appear
to be extensions of the root rather than flowers.

name: Petrified Root
description:
3️⃣A root that has been petrified in some kind of stone for likely millenia.
The durability it boasts can be used for a variety of purposes.

name: Deep Root
description:
4️⃣A root that is rather long, clearly one that ran deep deep into
the ground. Perhaps you should put it back so it can grow more?

name: Infinity Root
description:
5️⃣The root of the ages, reaching through both dirt and the spacetime continuum.
Legends say it eventually reaches back to itself through dimensions.

name: Imp Tongue
description:
1️⃣An imp's tongue is most commonly used in a variety of
witch's tinctures. Their sense of taste supposedly makes brews taste better.

name: Goblin Tongue
description:
2️⃣The counterfeit alternative to \Armor[326]s are obviously the super common
goblin tongues. Nevermind that goblins don't exist in this game.

name: Froggo Tongue
description:
3️⃣The tongue of a froggo is notoriously long and elastic. You could probably
use this in alchemy or something to JAFT the finest potions.

name: Dying Tongue
description:
4️⃣The tongue of a since-passed scholar, but you decided it would be somehow
more beneficial to rip the tongue out and use it for JAFTING.

name: Sinister Tongue
description:
5️⃣The emptiness radiates strongly off of this tongue. Clearly the most
maleficant of words not even an M-rated game would permit to be written in this text box were spoken with it.

name: Loose Scales
description:
1️⃣These scales are still attached to a membrane, but some are
actually starting to fall off.

name: Lizard Scales
description:
2️⃣These appear to be associated with some sort of lizard, but
after you fully destroyed the original owner, its tough to remember.

name: Enduring Scales
description:
3️⃣Some rather durable scales off a dragon or something otherwise that is
identifiable as "durable".

name: Wurm Scales
description:
4️⃣The scales off of a wurm deep deep in the subterranean depths.
The scales are difficult to see due to their inexplicable absorption of light.

name: Dargin Scales
description:
5️⃣The mightiest of mighty, scales off a dargin have all sorts of benefits,
including the ability to avoid crits.

name: Knubby Toe
description:
1️⃣A stubby little toe that never took its owner anywhere in a hurry.
Honestly it may be the reason you caught them at all.

name: Calloused Toe
description:
2️⃣This one has walked some serious distance, and has the hardened skin to prove it.
You are apparently a person who collects toes now.

name: Nimble Toe
description:
3️⃣Still twitching with the reflexes of something that was very good at not being hit.
It was, however, not quite good enough.

name: Sprinter's Toe
description:
4️⃣Whatever this came off of could outrun a horse, and did, right up until it did not.
It is still quicker than most of what is rattling around in that sack.

name: Blurred Toe
description:
5️⃣You cannot look directly at this toe. It keeps arriving slightly before your eyes do.
The original owner presumably never saw you coming either.

name: Green Clover
description:
1️⃣An entirely ordinary clover, plucked off whatever plant thing you flattened.
Three leaves, and not one of them lucky.

name: Four-Leaf Clover
description:
2️⃣One extra leaf, and suddenly the entire world treats it like a contract with fate.
The unsettling part is that it appears to work.

name: Five-Leaf Clover
description:
3️⃣Five leaves is one more than luck has ever strictly required.
Whether the spare helps or is simply showing off remains unresolved.

name: Golden Clover
description:
4️⃣The leaves are actual metal, making this a poor plant and a fairly good coin.
Nothing has gone wrong since you pocketed it, which is either proof or coincidence.

name: Impossible Clover
description:
5️⃣This clover has more leaves than it should, and the number differs every time you count.
Whatever it is doing to probability, it is doing it in your general vicinity.

name: Cracked Stinger
description:
1️⃣The stinger of a fallen enemy. Cracked to all hell because you
find it difficult to show restraint against such pitiful mobs.

name: Intact Stinger
description:
2️⃣Not very different from the \Armor[346], except that it
isn't cracked.

name: Sharp Stinger
description: 3️⃣A very pointy and sharp stinger that will do sharp stinger things as-needed.

name: Offensive Stinger
description:
4️⃣A ruthless stinger you barely escaped with your life with after ripping off the ass of
one of those stupid ass bees. They deserved it though, I promise.

name: Live Stinger
description:
5️⃣It is as though this stinger has muscles built into it, as it is still writhing and
twitching. Is it alive?!

name: Butter Wings
description:
1️⃣Float like a butterfly. That is the whole skillset, apparently.
For the sting like a bee half, see \Armor[346].

name: Silk Wings
description:
2️⃣Thin as silk, on account of being silk.
Harder to hit than anything actually wearing armor, somehow.

name: Whisper Wings
description:
3️⃣Owls fly silent. So did this, and it was extremely annoying.
You only got it because it had to land eventually.

name: Phantom Wings
description:
4️⃣Your hand goes through these about a quarter of the time.
Deeply unhelpful when you are trying to put them in a bag.

name: Vanishing Wings
description:
5️⃣You are fairly sure these are in the bag.
Checking has never once confirmed it.

name: Flimsy Fangs
description:
1️⃣A pair of fangs that are so flimsy, they might actually be
made of jelly. Did you get this from a Jelli?

name: Bone Fangs
description:
2️⃣Due to the fact that these incisors are made of bone, it is
tough to determine whether they are teeth, or mandibles.

name: Double Fangs
description:
3️⃣A pair of fangs that are strong and capable of piercing flesh.
Obviously not yours, though, since you walk away the victor with them in-hand.

name: Powerful Fangs
description: 4️⃣A mighty set of fangs, likely from a dragon or maybe a wolf.

name: Razor Fangs
description:
5️⃣Extremely sharp fangs that are quite possibly the sharpest thing you've ever
obtained. Even your item sack is concerned about being sliced open from these.

name: Busted Talon
description:
1️⃣Even as busted as this talon is, its still very pointy and
can probably do some damage.

name: Dull Talon
description:
2️⃣A talon still intact, but rather dull. Still dangerous, but
not as dangerous as the ones still attached to the owner.

name: Hooked Talon
description:
3️⃣Dangerously hooked, this talon is fully intact and probably could cause
some damage if you tried to use it that way.

name: Serrated Talon
description:
4️⃣A talon with micro-serrations all across the talon. This is very deadly
to have produced intact, hopefully it was worth it.

name: Lethal Talon
description:
5️⃣A wildly deadly talon with edges, hooks, blades, dripping with poison,
glowing with otherworldly power... Who knows what you would use this for.

name: Faded Core
description:
1️⃣The core of some sort of energy-based being.
Except that its completely faded and looks not far off from a regular rock.

name: Dimmed Core
description:
2️⃣A magical core that still glows faintly, but really can't deliver a lot.
Maybe you can charge it somehow?

name: Magic Core
description:
3️⃣The official core of a magic entity that derives its power from raw energy.
This is basically their battery, and you stole it from them.

name: Pulsating Core
description:
4️⃣A core still brimming with the energy of the enemy you just ripped it from.
It could probably power a lot of things!

name: Radiant Core
description:
5️⃣A brilliantly glowing core, overflowing with an abundance of energy!
Probably has equivalent energy output to a star going supernova.

name: Dead Branch
description:
1️⃣This is literally just a dead branch that some plant monster
probably dropped. Why did you pick it up?

name: Dry Branch
description:
2️⃣A branch that is a bit dry, but otherwise relatively sturdy.
It could probably be used for JAFTING in some way.

name: Preserved Branch
description:
3️⃣A branch that appears to have been preserved or something,
because it is definitely old, but still kinda firm.

name: Hard Branch
description:
4️⃣A branch that was hardened as though it was recently mined
out from a 74 layers deep archaeological dig.

name: Lark Branch
description:
5️⃣The branch at this point is not even really a branch, and also
somehow sings. This makes no sense, but you keep it anyway.

name: Loose Spines
description: 1️⃣Some quills still on the pelt are barely hangin' in there.

name: Red Spines
description:
2️⃣The pelt is almost as red as the quills, but at least
the quills aren't falling out.

name: Sharp Spines
description:
3️⃣Still intact and almost functional, the quills on this pelt are
surprisingly sharp for being dead for who knows how long.

name: Crimson Spines
description:
4️⃣Crimson like the blood they will draw if you come anywhere fucking
near these spikey boiz.

name: Quantum Spines
description:
5️⃣The pelt this animal came off of requires a special carrying case
due to the fact that the spines can poke holes into another dimension.

name: Crap Liver
description:
1️⃣A liver in genuinely terrible condition, taken from something with worse habits.
It still filters, technically, which is the part that matters.

name: Passable Liver
description:
2️⃣This one is merely unwell rather than actively failing.
A notable upgrade, given the category.

name: Healthy Liver
description:
3️⃣A clean, pink, entirely functional liver in suspiciously good condition.
Something out there was taking far better care of itself than you are.

name: Prime Liver
description:
4️⃣Whatever this came out of could probably have regrown a limb.
It certainly did not need the limb you took instead.

name: Immortal Liver
description:
5️⃣It has regenerated twice since going into the bag, both times larger.
You are now in a race with a liver, and you are losing.

name: Dense Pelt
description: 1️⃣A chunk of dense fur off of a beast or something.

name: Wisp Pelt
description:
2️⃣A pelt found under the ghastly aura of a wisp.
It is almost like touching a glowing bunny.

name: Bright Pelt
description:
3️⃣A vividly bright pelt of unnatural brightness and glory.
Was this monster you harvested this from a spawn from Dionysis or something?

name: Radiant Pelt
description:
4️⃣A gorgeous and shimmering pelt from a truly magnificent speciman.
Even the deities would be jealous of a mortal wearing something JAFTED from this.

name: Flowing Pelt
description:
5️⃣Even now that the beast you've scalped this off of is dead,
the fur of the pelt still almost looks like its flowing with some kind of ethereal wind.

name: Waxxy Ear
description:
1️⃣The ear from some kind of humanoid. Often fashioned into a very
stylish necklace in certain cultures, but this one is just waxxy and gross.

name: Pierced Ear
description:
2️⃣An ear that has been pierced a few times. In some cultures, it is normal to do that.
In others, it is just inefficient, and thus the pierced-ear-bearers are exterminated.

name: Complete Ear
description:
3️⃣One whole and complete ear.
It almost looks kinda like yours.

name: Bandit's Ear
description:
4️⃣When the bandit first approached you, you decided instead of listening that
just chopping their ear off was a better opening statement.

name: Lord's Ear
description: 5️⃣The ear of the lordiest lord in all the land.

name: Inert Veil
description:
1️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Dead Veil
description:
2️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Expired Veil
description:
3️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Perished Veil
description:
4️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Wasted Veil
description:
5️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Worn Stone
description:
1️⃣Your average everyday stone. These things have a multitude of
uses, but you can do what you want with it.

name: Round Stone
description:
2️⃣This \Armor[401] has been extra worn, as it is starting to get kinda round
and smooth on the edges.

name: Circular Stone
description:
3️⃣Rather than becoming even more round, the stone became more disk-like actually.
How strange to find such abnormalities in nature.

name: Trapezoidal Stone
description:
4️⃣It is unclear why you are now picking up such obscure-shaped stones off the ground.
Though, they do appear to grant some degree of benefit in JAFTING.

name: Spherical Stone
description:
5️⃣A stone that is a perfect sphere. It probably isn't even a stone to be honest.
It is likely some kind of highly advanced artifact of a time long past.

name: Bare Saline
description:
1️⃣Salt water, essentially, drained out of something that had far too much of it.
It does help wounds close, which nobody expected.

name: Buffered Saline
description:
2️⃣The same fluid, except it no longer stings on contact.
That alone makes it worth several times the plain stuff.

name: Enriched Saline
description:
3️⃣Thicker than it ought to be, and warm for no reason it will disclose.
Wounds treated with it close in about half the usual time.

name: Miracle Saline
description:
4️⃣A single drop closed a cut you had been ignoring for most of a week.
No explanation was offered and none appears to be forthcoming.

name: Panacea Saline
description:
5️⃣This fluid repairs whatever it touches, including things that were never alive.
The bag holding it has quietly stopped having a hole in it.

name: Taste Pills
description:
1️⃣Pills that do nothing whatsoever except make everything else taste correct.
Somehow this makes medicine work better, and nobody is asking why.

name: Chalky Pills
description:
2️⃣Dry, unpleasant, and shockingly effective at whatever it is they do.
Swallowing one without water is a mistake you make exactly once.

name: Coated Pills
description:
3️⃣Someone went to the trouble of making these easy to swallow.
That someone was almost certainly not the thing you took them from.

name: Prescription Pills
description:
4️⃣These came with written instructions, which raises more questions than it settles.
The instructions are not in any language you recognize.

name: Experimental Pills
description:
5️⃣Unlabeled, unmarked, and glowing very faintly around the edges.
Every remedy taken since has worked roughly twice as well as advertised.

name: Murky Liquids
description:
1️⃣A sludge of uncertain origin that magic seems to move through very easily.
Casting while holding it costs noticeably less effort.

name: Cloudy Liquids
description:
2️⃣Most of the sediment has settled out, leaving something almost drinkable.
Do not drink it.

name: Clear Liquids
description:
3️⃣Perfectly transparent, perfectly still, and reflecting slightly the wrong room.
Casting anything near it feels like walking downhill.

name: Distilled Liquids
description:
4️⃣Everything impure has been removed by a process nobody witnessed.
What remains is almost entirely conductive to magic.

name: Pure Liquids
description:
5️⃣There is nothing in this fluid at all, which should not be possible for a fluid.
Magic passes through it as though the cost were somebody else's problem.

name: Old Bone
description:
1️⃣The femur from a large animal- that must've been totally
obliterated based on how much is left of this bone.

name: Mossy Bone
description:
2️⃣A femur of some kind of humanoid that has long since been deceased.
It appears to be cracked beyond repair.

name: Earthen Bone
description:
3️⃣A femur that likely came from a large feline of some sort.
It appears completely intact.

name: Petrified Bone
description:
4️⃣A massive femur that could only have come from something equivalent to
a titan.

name: Spiral Bone
description:
5️⃣It is unclear what entity this femur belongs to, as it is completely intact
but also kind of elastic.

name: Flat Mineral
description:
1️⃣It is a mineral, and flat.
Unclear if this is a \Armor[401] in disguise.

name: Dense Mineral
description: 2️⃣Minerals harden when they reach a certain point. Might be useful for a shield?

name: Layered Mineral
description:
3️⃣Layer upon layer upon layer upon layer upon-
You get the point, it is hard as a rock. Obviously.

name: Reinforced Mineral
description:
4️⃣Basically a fancy name for \Armor[428] with yet more layers.
Oft confused with ogres whom also have layers.

name: Adamant Mineral
description:
5️⃣Preposterously hardened stone at this point-
Did you trade something pink for this?

name: Congruent Caviar
description:
1️⃣Fish eggs. Every one of them exactly the same size.
Magic finds this offensive for some reason.

name: Aligned Caviar
description:
2️⃣The eggs are in rows now. They were not in rows before.
Everyone has quietly agreed not to bring it up.

name: Resonant Caviar
description:
3️⃣Tap one and they all hum. Tap all of them and-
Actually, do not do that.

name: Harmonic Caviar
description:
4️⃣The humming turned into a chord and the chord is honestly kind of nice.
Still fish eggs, though.

name: Absolute Caviar
description:
5️⃣Magic gets close to these, thinks about it, and goes somewhere else.
Did the eggs do that, or did you?

name: Bent Plate
description:
1️⃣Armor plating, peeled off something that was upright until recently.
Bent, but still better between you and the floor than nothing.

name: Stamped Plate
description:
2️⃣Factory-pressed, with a serial number nobody has ever looked up.
Somewhere a machine made thousands of these and then stopped.

name: Riveted Plate
description:
3️⃣Two plates and one row of rivets, which is twice the plate.
Spikes have stopped being a conversation.

name: Hardened Plate
description:
4️⃣Heat-treated until it stopped caring about anything at all.
People have walked across coals in boots made of this. On purpose.

name: Ablative Plate
description:
5️⃣Built to be destroyed slowly so that you are not destroyed quickly.
The floor gets a layer. You get to keep your feet.

name: Spinny Fossil
description:
1️⃣A little spiral shell turned to stone an extremely long time ago.
Staring at it makes recent events feel easier to learn from.

name: Spiral Fossil
description:
2️⃣The coil is tighter and older, and the stone has gone almost black.
Lessons stick harder while it is in the bag.

name: Ancient Fossil
description:
3️⃣Old enough that whatever made it has no name anyone still remembers.
It has clearly been learning the entire time.

name: Primordial Fossil
description:
4️⃣This predates most of the things you would be willing to call things.
Being near it makes experience arrive faster and slightly uninvited.

name: Eternal Fossil
description:
5️⃣The spiral does not end. You have been following it inward for some time now.
You have learned a great deal and can recall none of it.

name: Pointy Tooth
description:
1️⃣A tooth that comes to a genuinely alarming point at one end.
It went in easily, which is presumably how its owner preferred to work.

name: Jagged Tooth
description:
2️⃣Not so much sharp as unevenly broken, which turns out to be worse.
A clean cut heals. This does not produce clean cuts.

name: Fanged Tooth
description:
3️⃣Long, curved, and grooved down one side for reasons best not dwelt upon.
The groove is there to let something out, or possibly in.

name: Savage Tooth
description:
4️⃣This tooth has been used hard and has plainly enjoyed every moment of it.
There is old damage on it that is not its own.

name: Executioner Tooth
description:
5️⃣Whatever this belonged to did not need a second attempt at anything.
Neither, it turns out, will you.

name: Crusty Seashell
description:
1️⃣One seashell. Only nineteen more.
Nobody has explained who wants these or why.

name: Ridged Seashell
description:
2️⃣Ridged, which apparently makes it a different seashell than the last one.
It does not. You are still collecting seashells.

name: Thick Seashell
description:
3️⃣Thicker than the others, for whatever that is worth.
It is worth nothing until you have all twenty.

name: Armored Seashell
description:
4️⃣At some point a seashell stops being a shell and becomes a chore.
That point was about twelve fucking seashells ago.

name: Impervious Seashell
description:
5️⃣The last seashell. Somewhere a wall is going to open.
It had better be a very good sword.

name: Frayed Feather
description:
1️⃣A tatty feather missing most of the bits that would make it useful.
It still catches the wind slightly, which is more than you expected.

name: Light Feather
description:
2️⃣So light that it takes a genuine act of will to keep hold of it.
It has escaped the bag twice and been recovered once.

name: Swift Feather
description:
3️⃣Dropped from waist height, this feather reaches the floor before you do.
That is the wrong way around and it has not been explained.

name: Gale Feather
description:
4️⃣There is a breeze coming off this thing that has no source.
Standing behind it is measurably easier than standing in front of it.

name: Stormborn Feather
description:
5️⃣This came off something that outran weather as a matter of routine.
The feather has not stopped moving since you acquired it.

name: Barely Acupuncture
description:
1️⃣A handful of needles and a great deal of confidence.
Roughly nine hundred and ninety needles short of impressive.

name: Passable Acupuncture
description:
2️⃣The needles go where they are aimed now, mostly.
Still nowhere near a thousand.

name: Practiced Acupuncture
description:
3️⃣Every needle lands exactly where it is meant to.
The count is climbing and that is starting to worry people.

name: Master Acupuncture
description:
4️⃣Nine hundred and ninety-nine needles, placed perfectly.
Everyone is waiting to see what happens on the next one.

name: Transcendent Acupuncture
description:
5️⃣One thousand needles.
Do not run. Running is what it wants.

name: Lost Rune
description:
1️⃣A chipped stone marked with something that was a letter a very long time ago.
Nobody can read it, and yet it insists on being informative.

name: Faded Rune
description:
2️⃣Most of the carving has worn away, leaving roughly a third of a statement.
The remaining third is somehow the useful part.

name: Legible Rune
description:
3️⃣For the first time, the marking on this stone is unambiguously a word.
It is not a word in any language, but it is definitely a word.

name: Humming Rune
description:
4️⃣The carving vibrates faintly whenever anyone nearby understands something.
It has been busy since you started carrying it.

name: Singing Rune
description:
5️⃣The stone is holding a single sustained note and has been for days.
You have begun to suspect it is explaining something at a speed you cannot follow.

name: Questionable Syringe
description:
1️⃣A syringe with a bent needle and a history you would rather not inherit.
It still draws, which is regrettably the only requirement.

name: Used Syringe
description:
2️⃣Cleaner than the last one, though the bar was buried underground.
Someone got a great deal of use out of this before you did.

name: Sterile Syringe
description:
3️⃣Genuinely, verifiably clean, which changes the entire character of the thing.
What it is for has not changed at all.

name: Surgical Syringe
description:
4️⃣Precise enough to take exactly as much as intended and not a drop more.
The restraint is the impressive part, not the capacity.

name: Vampiric Syringe
description:
5️⃣This one fills on its own if left unattended near anything with a pulse.
It has been left unattended exactly once.

name: Blue Aid
description:
1️⃣A pale blue draught that tastes the way a cold room feels.
Drinking near a caster leaves them noticeably less full of ideas.

name: Azure Aid
description:
2️⃣The colour has deepened and so, unhelpfully, has the cold.
It pulls harder now, and from further away.

name: Cobalt Aid
description:
3️⃣Dense, dark, and slow to pour, like the liquid is thinking it over.
Magic in the vicinity has started arriving here instead of where it was sent.

name: Sapphire Aid
description:
4️⃣Clear enough to read through and hard enough to be uncomfortable in a flask.
It is no longer obvious that this is a liquid at all.

name: Abyssal Aid
description:
5️⃣Looking into this is a commitment of several minutes that you did not intend to make.
Something down there is drinking, and it is not you.

name: Dead Cell
description:
1️⃣A battery with nothing left in it at all.
Something mechanical stopped moving so that you could have this.

name: Spare Cell
description:
2️⃣This one still holds a charge, which is a considerable step up.
Mecha apparently carry spares. Now so do you.

name: Charged Cell
description:
3️⃣Full, warm, and humming very faintly.
Holding it makes your teeth feel like they have opinions.

name: Surging Cell
description:
4️⃣There is more in this than the casing says there should be.
The casing is scratched off, so who is really to say.

name: Overloaded Cell
description:
5️⃣It has been venting for a while now and shows no sign of stopping.
Put it in the taser. Do not put it in your pocket.

name: Glow in a Jar
description:
1️⃣There is a light in the jar. There is nothing making the light.
It has never gone out.

name: Flicker in a Jar
description:
2️⃣The light moves now, like it is having a look around.
It stops when you look back.

name: Flare in a Jar
description:
3️⃣Bright enough to read by. Warm enough to want in winter.
The glass is stone cold, which is the part that bothers people.

name: Blaze in a Jar
description:
4️⃣It is a fire and it is not burning anything.
It has been not burning anything since you found it.

name: Star in a Jar
description:
5️⃣The jar is the same size it always was. The thing inside it is not.
Where is the extra room coming from?

name: Clogged Radiator
description:
1️⃣A heatsink packed solid with dust and whatever else got in there.
Still sheds heat, technically. Technically is doing a lot of work.

name: Vented Radiator
description:
2️⃣Cleaned out, with every fin present and accounted for.
Whatever it is cooling stays cool a good deal longer now.

name: Finned Radiator
description:
3️⃣Far more surface area than seems reasonable for the size of it.
Somebody put real effort into this before you took it off them.

name: Liquid Radiator
description:
4️⃣Coolant is still moving through this and nothing is pumping it.
Best not to think too hard about where the pump went.

name: Cryo Radiator
description:
5️⃣Cold enough that touching it barehanded was a one-time experiment.
The mecha this came out of never overheated. Not once.

name: Vague Memory
description:
1️⃣Someone else's recollection, kept somehow, and badly out of focus.
It is not yours, but holding it makes your own come back sharper.

name: Clouded Memory
description:
2️⃣Shapes and a colour and the strong impression of a room.
Still nobody you know, though the room is beginning to feel familiar.

name: Clear Memory
description:
3️⃣A complete scene, start to finish, belonging entirely to a stranger.
You could describe their kitchen in detail and you have never been there.

name: Vivid Memory
description:
4️⃣This one arrives with the smell attached, which nobody warned you about.
It is a good smell, and it is not a memory you are entitled to.

name: Perfect Memory
description:
5️⃣Nothing is missing from this recollection. Nothing at all.
You have begun to worry about which of your own it is displacing.

name: Yellowish Urn
description:
1️⃣A small pot of a colour that is trying quite hard to be gold.
Coins left inside it overnight are occasionally joined by others.

name: Brass Urn
description:
2️⃣Heavier, better made, and no longer pretending about what it is.
The overnight arrangement has become considerably more reliable.

name: Gilded Urn
description:
3️⃣A thin layer of real gold over something that was never worth gilding.
The dishonesty appears to be load-bearing.

name: Golden Urn
description:
4️⃣Solid, unreasonably valuable, and entirely happy to be carried around.
Selling it has been considered and immediately rejected several times.

name: Midas Urn
description:
5️⃣Things put into this come back out worth more than when they went in.
A great deal of care is now taken about what goes into it.

name: Dull Plank
description:
1️⃣A plain piece of wood. No face on it. Yet.
Things fall off monsters more often when it is around.

name: Splintered Plank
description:
2️⃣Somebody drew a face on it.
You did not draw the face.

name: Polished Plank
description:
3️⃣Sanded smooth, and the face is a lot clearer now.
It has been listening this whole time.

name: Lacquered Plank
description:
4️⃣Sealed under a finish you can see yourself in.
The plank has started making suggestions, and they are good suggestions.

name: Fortune Plank
description:
5️⃣It has never once been wrong about where the loot is.
It does not speak. You just know.

name: Old Skull
description:
1️⃣A skull the weather got to first.
Bleeding for your skills costs a bit less now. Unclear why.

name: Cracked Skull
description:
2️⃣Better shape than the last one, though something clearly disagreed with it.
The crack has not moved since.

name: Whole Skull
description:
3️⃣Every tooth still in it. Every single one.
This skull is in better condition than most of your gear.

name: Gleaming Skull
description:
4️⃣Someone has been polishing this and it is not you.
It gets brighter when nobody is looking at it.

name: Deathless Skull
description:
5️⃣Whatever this belonged to never quite finished dying.
It is being extremely patient about that. Weird.

name: Distorting Dust
description:
1️⃣A fine powder that makes everything behind it look a half-second out of place.
Waiting for anything is briefly less tedious while it is out.

name: Skipping Dust
description:
2️⃣Moments near this occasionally go missing without being noticed.
Nothing important has been lost yet, as far as anyone can establish.

name: Racing Dust
description:
3️⃣Everything in the immediate vicinity is running a little ahead of schedule.
This includes the things you would rather were running late.

name: Stuttering Dust
description:
4️⃣Time near this has developed a distinct and unwelcome rhythm.
You have caught yourself doing the same second twice on two occasions.

name: Timeless Dust
description:
5️⃣The powder does not settle, and it has not settled since you found it.
Whatever it is waiting for has evidently not happened yet.

name: Moving Leaf
description:
1️⃣A leaf that drifts a little further from your hand each time you reach for it.
There is no wind in here. There has never been any wind in here.

name: Drifting Leaf
description:
2️⃣This one has stopped bothering to look like it is falling naturally.
It goes where it likes and it takes its time about it.

name: Dodging Leaf
description:
3️⃣Attempts to grab this have now failed enough times to constitute a pattern.
The pattern is that you are not fast enough.

name: Weaving Leaf
description:
4️⃣It moves before the hand does, which is the wrong order for that to happen in.
You have started reaching for where it is going instead.

name: Untouched Leaf
description:
5️⃣Nothing has made contact with this leaf, including the tree it came off.
It is in the bag by mutual arrangement rather than by capture.

name: Livening Stick
description:
1️⃣A dry twig that has put out one small, extremely determined green shoot.
Anything mending nearby seems to take the hint.

name: Mending Stick
description:
2️⃣Snapped clean in half at some point and has since grown back together.
The join is stronger than the wood on either side of it.

name: Knitting Stick
description:
3️⃣New growth runs along this in tight woven bands like a closing wound.
It is doing to itself what you would very much like done to you.

name: Reviving Stick
description:
4️⃣Dead leaves pressed against this have been observed to go green again.
Nobody has yet been brave enough to try it on anything larger.

name: Everliving Stick
description:
5️⃣This branch has been separated from its tree for an unknown number of years.
It has not noticed, and at this point it would be unkind to mention it.
